Notice under Section 2(1) Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946

AS per the powers vested on me as Provincial Council (Ancillary Provisions) of 12 of 1989, I am M. K. Bandula Harischandra the Governor of Southern Province hereby inform that approved to impose and recover 10% of Entertainment Tax of the value of tickets issued as provisions of Sub Section (1) of Section 2 Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946 for Entertainment activities described in Entertainment Tax Ordinance (Amendment) No. 37 of 1984, Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946 and passed under decision No. 2024/04/05/01 in decision book by the Secretary of Mulatiyana Pradeshiya Sabha. M. K. Bൺඇൽඎඅൺ Hൺඋංඌർඁൺඇൽඋൺ, Governor, Southern Province. Governor’s Secretariat,Galle.29th October, 2024.

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

As per the powers vested under Entertainment Tax Ordinance (Amendment) No. 37 of 1984, Entertainment Tax Ordinance (1) of Section 2 of Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946. It is hereby proposed to Sabhawa to impose 10% of the value of tickets issued to the public as Entertainment Tax for Entertainment activities described in said act conducting within the limit of Mulatiyana Pradeshiya Sabha and this decision should activate from the ﬁ rst day of the month following the month of publication in the Gazette and I am the Secretary of Mulatiyana Pradeshiya Sabha further decided the Entertainment Tax impose above should pay by the organization or the organizer to the Mulatiyana Pradeshiya Sabha before the date if starting Entertainment activities.
